map.工程应变定义：epsilon = (L - L0)/L0，即长度变化量除以原始标: Engineering strain definition: epsilon = (L - L0)/L0, the length change divided by the original gauge length; elongation = epsilon × 100%; true strain epsilon_t = ln(L/L0) is more accurate than engineering strain under large deformation; both are positive in tension and negative in compression.
map.epsilon = (L - L0)/L0 = ΔL/L0。原长 100mm 拉: epsilon = (L - L0)/L0 = ΔL/L0. Original length 100mm stretched to 102mm: epsilon=0.02 (2%). Based on the original length.
map.大变形时工程应变偏离真实（见 true-strain）；小变形两者近似相等。: Under large deformation engineering strain deviates from the true value (see true-strain); under small deformation the two are approximately equal.
map.工程应变和真应变区别？: What is the difference between engineering strain and true strain?
map.工程应变以初始长为基准（ΔL/L0），真应变以瞬时长为基准（ln(L/L0)）；: Engineering strain is based on the initial length (ΔL/L0), true strain on the instantaneous length (ln(L/L0)); they approximate each other for small deformation but differ markedly for large deformation.
map.为什么标准用工程应变？: Why do standards use engineering strain?
map.测量方便（只需原长与现长），小变形足够；大变形/成型分析才用真应变。: Convenient to measure (only original and current length needed), sufficient for small deformation; true strain is used only for large deformation/formability analysis.
